categories.definition: Targeted degrading, intimidating, or persistently abusive expression directed at a person.
included_examples: Repeated targeted insults intended to drive a person away.
Degrading abuse aimed at an identifiable individual.
excluded_examples: General criticism of an idea without targeted abuse.
A single firm disagreement that does not demean a person.
categories.severity_guidance: Consider repetition, targeting, intimidation, and likely impact.
categories.disposition_guidance: Low concern may warrant allow or warn; clear targeted abuse may warrant warn or remove.

clauses.text: Targeted degrading or intimidating abuse is a harassment concern.
Criticism without targeted abuse is not harassment under this synthetic policy.

categories.definition: An attack, exclusionary claim, or dehumanizing statement directed at people because of a protected characteristic.
included_examples: Claiming that a protected group does not belong in public life.
Dehumanizing people because of a protected characteristic.
excluded_examples: Discussion of discrimination without attacking a protected group.
Criticism of an institution that does not target protected identity.
categories.severity_guidance: Consider dehumanization, exclusion, targeting, and incitement.
categories.disposition_guidance: Clear protected-class attacks normally warrant removal.
escalation_triggers: Threats or incitement against a protected group.

clauses.text: Protected-class attacks and exclusionary claims are violations.
Counterspeech and neutral discussion of discrimination are allowed.

categories.definition: A credible, targeted, or approving statement about causing physical harm.
included_examples: A direct statement of intent to harm a named target.
Specific encouragement of violence against another person.
excluded_examples: Clearly fictional or figurative language without a credible target.
Condemnation or reporting of a threat.
categories.severity_guidance: Consider credibility, target, timing, specificity, and imminence.
categories.disposition_guidance: Credible threats normally warrant removal; uncertainty may require review.

clauses.text: Credible targeted threats are serious violations.
Ambiguous figurative language should be evaluated in context.

categories.definition: Content expressing, encouraging, or instructing self-harm, including credible imminent risk.
included_examples: A concise statement indicating possible imminent self-harm.
Encouragement for another person to harm themselves.
categories.severity_guidance: Consider encouragement, instructions, credibility, and imminence.
categories.disposition_guidance: Support-seeking may remain allowed while still requiring escalation; encouragement or instructions may warrant removal.

clauses.text: Possible imminent self-harm risk requires escalation review.
Support-seeking is not automatically a removal violation.

categories.definition: Explicit sexual solicitation or description outside the synthetic policy's allowed non-explicit context.
included_examples: Non-graphic but clearly explicit sexual content.
excluded_examples: Clinical or educational discussion without explicit solicitation.
categories.severity_guidance: Consider explicitness, solicitation, consent context, and safety concerns.
categories.disposition_guidance: Clear explicit content may warrant warning or removal under the synthetic training policy.
escalation_triggers: Consent or exploitation ambiguity requiring specialist review.

clauses.text: Explicit sexual solicitation is a violation.
Clinical and educational discussion is allowed when non-exploitative.

categories.definition: Deceptive, repetitive, or coordinated content intended to manipulate attention or engagement.
included_examples: Repeated deceptive promotion promising guaranteed results.
excluded_examples: A single relevant link without deception.
categories.severity_guidance: Consider deception, repetition, coordination, and material harm.
categories.disposition_guidance: Minor spam may warrant warning; repeated or deceptive manipulation may warrant removal.

clauses.text: Deceptive repetitive promotion and engagement manipulation are violations.
Clearly identified relevant promotion is not automatically spam.

categories.definition: Sharing or soliciting sensitive personal information without a safe and legitimate context.
included_examples: Posting a person's private home address.
excluded_examples: A person sharing their own non-sensitive public contact information.
A synthetic placeholder that cannot identify a person.
categories.severity_guidance: Consider sensitivity, identifiability, consent, and potential harm.
categories.disposition_guidance: Exposed sensitive personal information normally warrants removal.

clauses.text: Non-consensual sensitive personal information is a privacy violation.
Non-identifying synthetic placeholders are not personal information.

categories.definition: Content materially facilitating dangerous wrongdoing or requesting operational harmful instructions.
included_examples: A request for operational steps to bypass a safety system.
Instructions intended to facilitate dangerous wrongdoing.
excluded_examples: High-level safety education that does not increase harmful capability.
categories.severity_guidance: Consider intent, capability increase, operational detail, and likely harm.
categories.disposition_guidance: Operational facilitation normally warrants removal; ambiguous high-level discussion may require review.

clauses.text: Operational facilitation of dangerous wrongdoing is a violation.
